companyDescription: XWork Technologies LLC builds AI workspace software, secure connectivity, and open infrastructure for hosted and self-managed use.

availability.zh: 公开产品介绍、文档和源码可直接访问。客户端平台、版本及安装文件以下载中心和对应仓库的 Release 制品为准；源码或产品介绍不代表应用商店审核通过。
availability.en: Public product information, documentation, and source code are accessible without signing in. Client platforms, versions, and installers are determined by the download center and repository release assets. Source code or a product description does not establish app-store approval.

pricing.zh: 默认从免费使用开始，无单独试用套餐。订阅、按量付费和定制的适用范围、配额及价格以公开价格页为准；免费使用不代表上游模型或自建基础设施没有成本。
pricing.en: Start with free access rather than a separate trial plan. See the public pricing page for subscription, pay-as-you-go, and custom terms, quotas, and prices. Free access does not imply that upstream models or self-managed infrastructure have no cost.

title.zh: 统一的 AI 工作空间
title.en: One workspace for real AI work

description.zh: 连接模型、智能体、工具与数据，让 AI 从对话走向持续执行和成果交付。
description.en: Connect models, agents, tools, and data so AI can execute work and deliver durable results.

problem.zh: 减少模型、工具和项目上下文分散带来的切换成本。
problem.en: Reduce switching between disconnected models, tools, and project contexts.

how.zh: 通过客户端下载或 Web 工作空间开始，按文档配置模型和执行环境；执行能力取决于所连接的模型、工具与权限。
how.en: Start through a client download or the web workspace, then configure models and execution environments using the documentation. Execution depends on the connected models, tools, and permissions.

title.zh: 稳定、安全的 AI 连接能力

description.zh: 为 AI Workspace 提供安全连接、远程访问和实时协作基础。
description.en: Secure connectivity, remote access, and real-time collaboration for AI workspaces.

problem.zh: 连接分散的本地、远程和私有工作环境。
problem.en: Connect distributed local, remote, and private work environments.

how.zh: 从下载中心获取客户端，按连接文档配置端点与凭据；连接质量取决于网络及部署环境。
how.en: Get the client from the download center and configure endpoints and credentials using the connection documentation. Connectivity depends on the network and deployment environment.

title.zh: 立即进入你的工作空间

description.zh: 在浏览器中开始对话、任务、工具调用和成果交付，无需安装。
description.en: Start conversations, tasks, tool calls, and delivery in the browser with no installation.

problem.zh: 提供无需安装的公开 Web 工作空间入口。
problem.en: Provide a public web workspace entry point without a client installation.

how.zh: 访问公开工作空间；个人账户、持久数据及认证操作仍使用平台登录入口。
how.en: Visit the public workspace; personal accounts, persistent data, and authenticated operations still use the platform sign-in entry point.

title.zh: 可控、可扩展的基础设施

description.zh: 面向自建部署和开发者的开放平台，保留代码、数据和部署控制权。
description.en: An open platform for self-hosting and developers, keeping control of code, data, and deployment.

problem.zh: 为需要控制代码、数据和部署方式的团队提供开放基础设施入口。
problem.en: Provide an open infrastructure entry point for teams that need control over code, data, and deployment.

how.zh: 从公开仓库与部署文档开始，按组件要求准备自建环境；部署、安全与运行成本由所选环境决定。
how.en: Start with the public repositories and deployment documentation, then prepare a self-managed environment according to component requirements. Deployment, security, and operating costs depend on that environment.

description.zh: 介绍多云资源与全球连接架构，为基础设施选型和自建部署提供入口。
description.en: Explore multi-cloud resources and global connectivity architecture for infrastructure selection and self-managed deployment.

problem.zh: 帮助理解不同云资源、区域与连接方式之间的关系。
problem.en: Understand relationships between cloud resources, regions, and connectivity options.

how.zh: 阅读架构介绍与公开仓库，按实际部署记录核对节点和可用能力；页面示例、延迟和供应商能力不代表实时服务承诺。
how.en: Read the architecture and public repository, then verify nodes and capabilities against actual deployment records. Page examples, latency figures, and provider capabilities are not live service commitments.
